description: Use this when you want to remove a trader from your watchlist; returns a confirmation and is safe to repeat. To add a trader use trader_watch.

auth_token.description: Session token for your X-verified account. Read it from the MT_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable; if it is not set, call trader_login first.
auth_token.title: Auth Token

target_handle.description: X handle of the trader to remove from your watchlist, with or without @.
target_handle.title: Target Handle

name: trader_unwatch
